owner: config openrouter_routing, providers openrouter_routing, and the shared OpenAI-compatible transport (lm_studio) request and 2xx paths
synthetic_basis: Every case is hand-authored from the Issue #939 contract; no relay capture, benchmark task, grader input, expected answer, past run record, endpoint, host path, header, or credential is copied. Provider slugs are illustrative strings, not a list of real providers.
legacy_bytes: fixtures/cases.json legacy.request and legacy.provider_request are the serialized forms of the request and provider_request event the generic transport produced at base_sha for one user turn without tools. They are the base-SHA builders' output (src/providers/openai_chat_completions.rs, src/providers/openai_responses.rs, and the provider_request emitter, none changed by this issue), matching the legacy_body values tests/compatible_reasoning_effort.rs already asserts at that SHA; they were not generated by the new implementation.
derived_fixture: tests/openrouter_provider_routing.rs runs each case in a child process with a cleared environment, a temporary HOME and workspace, and loopback stand-ins bound to 127.0.0.1:0; wire cases compare the received body and events against a companion run of the same case without the routing line, and no case reaches a real provider.
